data.one_liner: A Dart GraphQL client offering queries, mutations, subscriptions and cache management.
data.what_it_does: Provides a GraphQLClient to send queries, mutations and subscriptions to any GraphQL server. Includes built‑in caching, persistence via HiveStore and link composition for authentication and websockets.
use_when: You need a full‑featured GraphQL client in a pure Dart/Flutter app
You want built‑in caching, persistence and link system for auth or websockets
avoid_when: You only need simple HTTP GET/POST without GraphQL features
You prefer a code‑gen based client like graphql_flutter's generated types
strengths: Rich feature set: caching, persistence, link composition
Supports queries, mutations, subscriptions and custom links
weaknesses: Setup can be verbose compared to plain HTTP calls
No built‑in code generation; you must handle types manually
data.setup_notes: Add graphql to pubspec, optionally add hive/hive_ce for persistence, initialize HiveStore if using cache persistence

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: For simple REST/GraphQL calls without caching or link system

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers advanced HTTP features and interceptors, useful for basic GraphQL over HTTP
